about: Lyudmilovsk's urban plan (tools/city_plan.py, docs/city_plan.md). map = world_map metres (X west/sea, Y north, Z up); ue = Unreal cm (needs the portal face Y: portal_face_y). yaw = Unreal degrees the front faces (0 = +X, the sea).

serpentine_slab.after: Brazilian modernism: a long curved slab on pilotis with brise-soleil following the contour (after Reidy's Pedregulho, Rio, 1947)

wave_tower.after: Brazilian modernism: a tall slab with wavy horizontal brise-soleil (after Niemeyer's Copan, São Paulo, 1966)

capsule_tower.after: Japanese metabolism: capsule flats plugged onto two cores (after Kurokawa's Nakagin, Tokyo, 1972)

twin_cylinder_house.after: Constructivism: two interlocking cylinders with hexagonal windows (after Melnikov's house, Moscow, 1929)

commune_slab.after: Constructivism: a slab on pilotis with ribbon windows and a roof garden (after Narkomfin, Moscow, 1930)

stacked_beam_tower.after: Brutalism: crossed horizontal bars on cores over the slope (after Tbilisi's Ministry of Highways, 1975)

workers_club.after: Constructivism: cantilevered halls over the street (after Melnikov's Rusakov Club, Moscow, 1928)

shell_market.after: Hyperbolic-paraboloid concrete umbrellas (after Candela's market halls, Mexico)

culture_block.after: Concrete towers with irregular window holes and sky bridges (after Bo Bardi's SESC Pompéia, São Paulo, 1982)

terrace_riser_housing.after: Japanese hillside housing stepping up a terrace riser (after Rokko Housing, Kobe, Ando, 1983)

amber_pavilion.after: The restaurant thread's round glass pavilion under a concrete disc roof

hyperboloid_tower.after: A steel lattice hyperboloid, the pier's lighthouse and water tank (after Shukhov's towers, 1896-1922)

wave_canopy.after: A long free-form concrete canopy on thin columns over the fair (after Niemeyer's Marquise, Ibirapuera, 1954)

cube_houses.after: Cubes tilted 45 degrees on hexagonal pylons, a row over a footpath (after Blom's Kubuswoningen, Rotterdam, 1984)

round_sanatorium.after: A ring of cantilevered concrete cells round a courtyard (after Druzhba sanatorium, Yalta, 1985)

unite_block.after: A long brutalist slab on pilotis with a street of shops halfway up and a roof terrace (after Le Corbusier's Unité, Marseille, 1952)

stacked_boxes.after: Prefab boxes stacked in a terraced heap with roof gardens (after Safdie's Habitat 67, Montreal, 1967)

saucer_pavilion.after: A round concrete saucer on a ring of legs (after Kyiv's Lybid 'flying saucer', 1971)

bus_stop_kiosk.after: Small concrete shelters and kiosks in wild shapes (after Soviet bus stops, 1960s-80s)

lifeguard_tower.after: A tall concrete lifeguard tower with a cabin on top

tidal_pool.after: Concrete sea pools set in the beach that fill at high water (after Siza's Leça pools, 1966)

department_store.after: Glazed shop floors under a mosaic upper facade and a roof sign (Soviet univermag)

school.after: A low modernist school with a courtyard and sports ground

plain_block.after: An ordinary 4-5 storey house (filler; the buildings thread may swap it for any type)
